import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleRationalGenerators
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CurveDivisorGluing
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.MulEquiv
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.DivisorSheafZero
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.FiberDivisor

/-!
# Divisors of rational line-bundle generators

Two rational generators of the same module of regular sections have the same
order at every point of the open. Applied on overlaps of trivializations, this
makes their principal-divisor coefficients compatible for divisor gluing.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LineBundle

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]

/-- A regular multiple has no larger pole valuation at a point of its open. -/
theorem ord_le_of_mem_span_singleton
    (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U] {a b : X.functionField}
    (ha : a ∈ Submodule.span Γ(X, U) {b})
    {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx a ≤
      ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx b := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp ha
  have hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
    Scheme.genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty (U.nonempty_iff.mp inferInstance)
  change (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hηU).hom r * b = a at hr
  rw [← hr, map_mul]
  calc
    ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx
          ((X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hηU).hom r) *
        ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx b
      ≤ 1 * ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx b := by
        gcongr
        rw [Scheme.germ_generic_eq_algebraMap_germ hηU hxU r]
        exact Scheme.ord_algebraMap_stalk_le_one K hx _
    _ = _ := one_mul _

/-- Equal regular-section spans give equal point valuations. -/
theorem ord_eq_of_span_singleton_eq
    (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U] {a b : X.functionField}
    (hab : Submodule.span Γ(X, U) {a} = Submodule.span Γ(X, U) {b})
    {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx a =
      ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx b := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply ord_le_of_mem_span_singleton K U _ hx hxU
    rw [← hab]
    exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton a)
  · apply ord_le_of_mem_span_singleton K U _ hx hxU
    rw [hab]
    exact Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton b)

variable [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- Principal divisors of two generators of the same regular-section lattice
have equal coefficients on that open. -/
theorem coeffAt_divOf_eq_of_span_singleton_eq
    (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U] (a b : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hab : Submodule.span Γ(X, U) {(a : X.functionField)} =
      Submodule.span Γ(X, U) {(b : X.functionField)})
    {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    coeffAt hx (divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) a) =
      coeffAt hx (divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) b) := by
  have h := ord_eq_of_span_singleton_eq K U hab hx hxU
  rw [ord_val_eq K a hx, ord_val_eq K b hx,
    divisorBound_eq_coeffAt, divisorBound_eq_coeffAt] at h
  have hc := congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (WithZero.exp_injective h)
  change -coeffAt hx (divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) a) =
      -coeffAt hx (divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) b) at hc
  exact neg_injective hc

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A frame has one rational generator on every nonempty ambient subopen. -/
theorem exists_rationalGenerator_on_ambient_subopens
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (W : X.Opens) [Nonempty W]
    (e : L.restrict W.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) :
    ∃ q : X.functionFieldˣ, ∀ (U : X.Opens) (_ : U ≤ W) (_ : Nonempty U),
      LinearMap.range (rationalSectionLinearMap L hL U) =
        Submodule.span Γ(X, U) {(q : X.functionField)} := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hgen⟩ := exists_rationalGenerator_on_subopens L hL W e
  refine ⟨Units.mk0 q hq, ?_⟩
  intro U hUW hU
  let V : W.toScheme.Opens := W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U
  have hV : Nonempty V := by
    obtain ⟨x⟩ := hU
    exact ⟨⟨⟨x.val, hUW x.property⟩, x.property⟩⟩
  have hUV : W.ι ''ᵁ V = U := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact hz
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨⟨x, hUW hx⟩, hx, rfl⟩
  have h := hgen V hV
  let A : {U : X.Opens // Nonempty U} :=
    ⟨W.ι ''ᵁ V, ⟨⟨W.ι hV.some.val, ⟨hV.some.val, hV.some.property, rfl⟩⟩⟩⟩
  let B : {U : X.Opens // Nonempty U} := ⟨U, hU⟩
  let P (Z : {U : X.Opens // Nonempty U}) : Prop :=
    letI := Z.property
    LinearMap.range (rationalSectionLinearMap L hL Z.val) =
      Submodule.span Γ(X, Z.val) {q}
  have hAB : A = B := Subtype.ext hUV
  have hP : P A := h
  have hPB : P B := hAB ▸ hP
  exact hPB

/-- The rational generators of an actual line bundle glue to a finite-support
divisor. Its coefficients are the negatives of their classical orders. -/
theorem exists_divisor_of_rationalGenerators
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L) :
    ∃ D : X.CurveDivisor, ∀ x : X,
      ∃ (W : X.Opens) (_ : x ∈ W) (q : X.functionFieldˣ),
        IsAffineOpen W ∧
        (∀ (U : X.Opens) (_ : U ≤ W) (_ : Nonempty U),
          LinearMap.range (rationalSectionLinearMap L hL U) =
            Submodule.span Γ(X, U) {(q : X.functionField)}) ∧
        ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ W →
          coeffAt hz D = coeffAt hz (-divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) := by
  classical
  have hL' := hL
  choose W hxW hW e using hL'
  have hgen (x : X) : ∃ q : X.functionFieldˣ,
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hUW : U ≤ W x) (_ : Nonempty U),
        LinearMap.range (rationalSectionLinearMap L hL U) =
          Submodule.span Γ(X, U) {(q : X.functionField)} := by
    letI : Nonempty (W x) := ⟨⟨x, hxW x⟩⟩
    exact exists_rationalGenerator_on_ambient_subopens L hL (W x) (e x).some
  choose q hq using hgen
  have hcompat (i j : X) (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X)
      (hi : z ∈ W i) (hj : z ∈ W j) :
      coeffAt hz (-divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (q i)) =
        coeffAt hz (-divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (q j)) := by
    let U := W i ⊓ W j
    letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨z, hi, hj⟩⟩
    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_neg, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_neg]
    apply congrArg Neg.neg
    exact coeffAt_divOf_eq_of_span_singleton_eq K U (q i) (q j)
      ((hq i U inf_le_left inferInstance).symm.trans
        (hq j U inf_le_right inferInstance)) hz ⟨hi, hj⟩
  haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace
    (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := CurveDivisor.exists_eq_on_openCover W
    (fun x => ⟨x, hxW x⟩)
    (fun x => -divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (q x)) hcompat
  exact ⟨D, fun x => ⟨W x, hxW x, q x, hW x, hq x, hD x⟩⟩

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LineBundle
